title: A novel diabetic foot ulcer diagnostic model: identification and analysis of genes related to glutamine metabolism and immune infiltration.
summary: The study reports a glutamine-metabolism/immune-infiltration diabetic-foot-ulcer signature and diagnostic classifiers evaluated in public cohorts; this is a specific candidate diagnostic result with retrospective-data limits.
ai_technology: Machine-learning analysis applies the stated model to the paper’s medicine dataset and evaluates the reported outcome.
